**Subject: Re: Broken on arrival AGAIN (Order #58213)**

Hi Jordan,

I'm so sorry your kettle arrived with a cracked lid again. After four years with us, that's not the experience you deserve, and I completely understand your frustration.

I'd like to make this right by sending a replacement right away, at no cost to you. We'll also inspect the packaging on our end to help prevent this from happening a third time. If you can reply with a quick photo of the damage, I'll get the replacement shipped immediately.

Thank you for your patience and for sticking with us all these years.

Warm regards,
[Your name]
[Company name]
